scope: Official documentation and public disclosure source review only; no live data API acceptance or full-universe collection.
rightsPrinciple: An open web page, an open-source client, a provider account or sufficient points do not by themselves prove permission to redistribute an entire source database through a public repository. Verify the exact feed and intended display rights before publication.

officialSources.limits: No anonymous bulk API rate, pagination contract or database redistribution license verified.

officialSources.name: 上交所融资融券明细

officialSources.name: 上交所法律声明

officialSources.frequency: Terms as read on the verification date.

officialSources.usage: This review does not interpret the notice as a grant to republish full-market quote or Level-2 databases. Verify intended display and distribution rights separately.

officialSources.name: 证监会2026年公募定期报告格式准则
officialSources.coverage: Publicly offered fund quarterly, interim and annual reports.
officialSources.frequency: Effective 2026-05-01; quarterly reports within 15 working days after quarter-end, interim reports within two months after half-year-end, annual reports within three months after year-end.
officialSources.limits: Report-period-end information is not information known at period end. Actual disclosed security scope must be retained; not a live portfolio feed.
officialSources.usage: The new rule replaces the listed prior annual/interim/quarterly formats and older XBRL templates. Parse the actual report rather than assuming old templates remain current.

officialSources.usage: Use official fund-manager, custodian and CSRC disclosure documents with their original dates.

tushareAccessAndPrice.reason: This review verified documentation point thresholds, not a purchase quote. Points are access gates, not RMB prices. Do not promise that the required points or separate real-time/featured-data permissions are free.

conflicts.resolution: Document the conflict and use current endpoint requirements as the planned minimum; verify the actual account before collecting.
Do not use the older copy as the current pagination contract.

institutionEvidencePriorities.mustNotClaim: An announcement was known before publication; an unverified headline is a confirmed favorable catalyst.
Attending institutions bought the stock or currently hold it.
The disclosed subset is the full market institution ledger, or seat names identify final owners.
Previous-day broker-reported balances are intraday institution flows or complete market coverage.
Reported period-end holdings are current positions; omission from limited disclosures proves a sale; period changes reveal exact daily trades.

implementationBoundary: Research evidence only. No new schedule, API account, secret storage, trading endpoint or public provider-data feed is authorized or enabled by this file.
